description: Catalog rows that are not scan targets and must not sit in a scanner gallery: a blank, glare-saturated or empty-pocket crop embeds within 0.93 of a Double-Faced Substitute Card render, above every strong-accept point, so these rows turn degenerate input into confident wrong accepts. Publishers drop matching rows when they re-pack an index (browser); native clients mirror the same patterns in their metadata eligibility so already-published packs are protected. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions over the row name. See docs/scanner-system/game-acceptance-policy.md.

magic.evidence: 2026-08-29 index audit of visual-style-v2: 58 substitute cards, 118 World Championship bio cards, 107 emblems, 26 punchcards, 9 checklists in the gallery; a flat white crop scored 0.932 vs a substitute card with a 0.07 margin.

pokemon.evidence: physical-v2 audit found no non-card rows (23 attractor rows total, all real cards).
